summary: New product skill diorama-app-motion (experimental): motion in a consumer app — Diorama components and effects own their motion and are never double-animated; product interactions use transitions.dev snippets installed and credited in the app under the Transitions.dev License, which forbids republishing the collection, so the skill ships no snippet code; one snippet per element, no nested accordions (descendant selector), digit swaps restored to plain textContent, replay by reflow, JS timers reading durations from CSS variables, an explicit reduced-motion check for JS-driven motion, motion never the only feedback channel, and a review method (10% playback, every state).
